general.title: General
general.themeDesc: The look of the app. Light and dark are fixed; System follows your operating system.
general.languageDesc: Interface language. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
general.reopenLastVaultDesc: Nodus opens the vault you were using when the app starts.
general.confirmFileDeletionDesc: Nodus asks before deleting a file or folder from the tree.
general.openLinksInNewTab: Open links in a new tab
general.openLinksInNewTabDesc: A regular click on an internal link does not replace the current tab.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDesc: Choose the light, dark, or system theme.
appearance.customDesc: Create your own palettes from the current appearance.
appearance.empty: There are no custom themes yet. Create the first one from the current appearance.
appearance.name: Name
appearance.baseDesc: Controls system colors that the palette does not override.
appearance.fontDesc: Enter the name of an installed system font. Leave blank to use the default.
appearance.monospaceFontDesc: Used for code, hotkeys, and technical values.

editor.title: Editor
editor.fontSizeDesc: Text size of the note in pixels. The rest of the interface stays the same.

graph.title: Graph
graph.showLabelsDesc: Show note titles under nodes. Labels only appear at sufficient zoom.
graph.nodeSizeDesc: Base scale of nodes. Relative size depends on the note's link count.
graph.linkThicknessDesc: Thickness of the lines between connected nodes.
graph.centerStrengthDesc: How strongly nodes are pulled toward the center into a compact circle.
graph.linkDistanceDesc: Distance between linked nodes in the layout.
graph.repulsionDesc: How strongly nodes push each other apart. Higher means a roomier layout.
graph.linkStrengthDesc: How strongly connected nodes pull toward each other.
graph.localDepthDesc: How many link hops from the current note the local graph shows.
graph.colors_backgroundDesc: Graph background color. Empty uses the theme default.
graph.colors_linkDesc: Color of the lines between nodes.
graph.colors_accentDesc: Color of the hovered node and neighbor highlight.

vault.title: Vault
vault.pathDesc: The folder that holds your notes. You can switch it at any time.

dailyNotes.title: Daily notes
dailyNotes.folderDesc: Vault-relative folder daily notes live in.
dailyNotes.templatePathDesc: Vault-relative path to a template file, or leave blank for an empty note.
dailyNotes.openOnStartupDesc: Opens today's note automatically when Nodus starts.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.autoCompletionDateDesc: Appends a ✅ date when a task is checked off.

history.title: Version history
history.enabledDesc: Snapshots each note as it's edited, so old versions can be restored.
history.maxVersionsPerNoteDesc: Oldest versions are dropped past this limit.
history.maxAgeDaysDesc: Versions older than this are dropped.
history.maxTotalSizeMbDesc: Oldest versions are dropped to stay under this.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.vaultFolderNameDesc: Vault-relative folder every attachment goes into.
attachments.subfolderNameDesc: Named subfolder inside each note's own folder.
attachments.loadExternalImagesDesc: Fetches images linked by URL, not just local files.

sync.title: Sync
sync.simpleIntro: Choose one method. The connection is completed here; there is no need to switch to the sidebar.
sync.offDesc: Notes stay on this device only.
sync.mechanismDesc: How this vault stays in sync across devices.
sync.gitEncryptionWarning: Git sync stores your notes in plain text in the repository.

git.title: Git
git.simpleDesc: For your own GitHub, GitLab, or local repository.
git.connectDesc: Leave the URL empty to use local Git history only.
git.remoteOptionalHint: Optional for a local repository. Private repository credentials are configured in the sync panel.
git.remoteUrlDesc: Where this vault's Git repository is hosted.
git.autocommitDesc: When Nodus commits your changes automatically.
git.autocommitIntervalDesc: How often Nodus commits for you.
git.autopullOnStartupDesc: Pulls the latest changes when Nodus opens this vault.
git.commitMessageTemplateDesc: %date% is replaced with the current date/time.

server.title: Nodus server
server.simpleDesc: Encrypted Nodus sync between your devices.
server.connectDesc: Generate the code on an already connected device in its sync panel.
server.pairCodeHint: A short one-time code from another device.
server.baseUrlDesc: Address of your Nodus sync server.
server.autoSyncDesc: When Nodus syncs with the server automatically.
server.autoSyncIntervalDesc: How often Nodus syncs with the server for you.

telegram.simpleIntro: Choose where the bot runs. For the usual setup, you only need a token from @BotFather.
telegram.offDesc: The bot and Mini App do not run.
telegram.localSimpleDesc: Runs while Nodus is open on this computer.
telegram.serverSimpleDesc: Runs around the clock on your Nodus server.
telegram.connectDesc: Paste the token; Nodus starts the tunnel, creates a code, and opens Telegram.
telegram.botTokenSimpleDesc: Copy the token from @BotFather. It is kept only until Nodus closes.
telegram.connectHint: The first connection may take a moment.
telegram.invalidToken: Telegram rejected the token. Check it and try again.
telegram.tunnelTimeout: The tunnel started, but no public address appeared. Try again or enter an address under Advanced.
telegram.codeFallback: If the link does not open, enter {{code}} in the Mini App.
telegram.enabledDesc: Adds a Mini App and a companion bot for this vault. Requires a sync method above to actually be reachable.
telegram.placementDesc: Local: this computer serves the Mini App itself, only while it's running. Server: your Nodus server serves it around the clock instead.
telegram.serverPlacementNote: Configure the bot token on the Nodus server with the --telegram-bot-token startup flag. There is nothing more to set up here.
telegram.botTokenDesc: From @BotFather, kept only for this session's local server to verify Telegram's signature.
telegram.manualAddressDesc: Fallback address for the Mini App to reach this computer at, if the automatic tunnel isn't available.
telegram.generateCodeDesc: Shows a short code. Enter it in the Mini App to connect this vault to your Telegram account.
telegram.codeHint: Valid for 10 minutes. Enter it in the Mini App to finish linking.
telegram.startLinkHint: You can skip typing the code. Open this link on the phone with Telegram to finish linking in one tap.
telegram.startTunnelDesc: Opens a temporary public address via a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel with no account required. Downloads the small cloudflared tool automatically the first time.
telegram.startingTunnel: Starting… (downloads cloudflared the first time, may take a moment)
